benchmark.name: EQUAL_WEIGHT_BUY_AND_HOLD
benchmark.assumptions: Buy equal allocations at first selected session open, same fees/slippage, hold to final close. No stops or active-strategy exposure caps.

initial_stop_loss.basis: Completed signal close; fixed before later-open fill. Percentage is before fees, slippage and gaps.
initial_stop_loss.trailing_relationship: Trailing stop can tighten the initial stop from subsequent eligible sessions; it never lowers it.

stock_selection.note: Signals ranked at each completed close; actual next-open quantity is recalculated. No LLM-selected portfolio returns.

disclaimer: Deterministic historical simulation only. ROUTER is code-based, NOT OpenRouter C2.
limitation: Synthetic deterministic routing ablation; no real-market or LLM-return claim.
